children: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent pushed back on the idea that the U.S. is in a symmetrical trade war with Canada, telling CNBC that Prime Minister Mark Carney is playing domestic politics rather than working toward a viable trade deal. "I don't think you can be in a tit-for-tat with someone who's 13 times larger than you are," Bessent says in an interview with CNBC. Canada was offered the best trade deal of any country on the globe and Carney chose to walk away from it at the last minute, Bessent says. "He's doing what is best for the Liberal Party, what's best for Mark Carney, and in the long run, the other Canadian people are going to see through that," he says. (dean.seal@wsj.com)
